title: Pitbull Shares the Stories Behind ‘On the Floor,’ ‘Feel This Moment’ & More | Chart History
summary: Pitbull looks back on the stories behind some of his biggest hits, from “On the Floor” with Jennifer Lopez to “I Know You Want Me (Calle Ocho)” and “Give Me Everything” to “Timber” and “I Like It.” He shares how collaborations with artists such as Ne-Yo, Kesha, Lil Jon and Enrique Iglesias came together, why […]
